thought.text: MinIO binary verified (sha256 matches the published sum file). Now download mc:

reasoning_content: The checksum matched (the "FAILED open or read" error was just because the sum file references the original filename, but the sha256 hashes match: both are 7c5bd8512c6e966455b1d198209358b2d191c77a83ab377c4073281065fb855f). Alright, let's download mc.

action.command:
set -e
cd /workspace/.local-images/mc
curl -sL --max-time 500 -o mc "https://github.com/minio/mc/releases/download/RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z/mc.linux-amd64.RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z"
curl -sL --max-time 60 -o mc.sha256sum "https://github.com/minio/mc/releases/download/RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z/mc.linux-amd64.RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z.sha256sum"
ACT=$(sha256sum mc | cut -d' ' -f1); EXP=$(awk '{print $1}' mc.sha256sum); echo "actual=$ACT"; echo "expect=$EXP"; [ "$ACT" = "$EXP" ] && echo CHECKSUM_OK || echo CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
ls -la
